## Summary

Continuation of #32041 by @hxhhhlalala, limited to its remaining automatic FA backend selection. The MXFP8 attention implementation landed in #39438; this follows the [maintainer's suggestion](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32041#issuecomment-6008020716) to submit backend selection separately. The original author is credited as a co-author.

With `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_ENABLE_MXFP8_ATTENTION=1` and a supported quantization config on Ascend, attention layers can currently default to SDPA unless FA is selected explicitly. Pass the layer's quantization config to the selector and reuse `resolve_mx_fa_scheme` to select FA automatically when no backend or layer default has been specified.

- Covers `LocalAttention`, `UlyssesAttention`, and `USPAttention`.
- Preserves explicit layer, global, CLI, component, and attention-role selections, as well as supported-backend constraints.
- Keeps automatic cross-attention selection unchanged. Device, operator, and dtype eligibility remain governed by the existing MXFP8 resolver.

Updated on 2026-10-22 with an ordinary merge of main `3d508d614f`; head `ceace1a8d3`. The feature remains a three-file backend-selection change. It has no unmerged source prerequisite and does not include the separate Linear refactor #44365. The original PR's kernel implementation, environment variable names, and historical performance results are not carried forward.

## Validation

- All 10 CPU unittest methods passed again on the updated head, covering online/offline config routing, opt-in and capability fallback, backend precedence, constraints, and all three layer constructors.
- The isolation harness uses the actual selector/resolver and layer constructor bodies, with package startup isolated and NPU capabilities mocked. Against current unmodified main `3d508d614f`, the constructor regression fails for all three self-attention layers because they select SDPA.
- Applicable Ruff hook rules, formatting, isort, codespell, syntax, test-placement/registration checks, and the PR diff check passed.
- Full runtime test collection remains unavailable locally: package startup fails on missing `orjson` before reaching the tests.

**Target validation is pending for this head:** run the existing Wan2.2 I2V ModelSlim MXFP8 checkpoint on Ascend 950 with the opt-in enabled and no explicit attention-backend override. Require both successful generation and the existing runtime message `Using MXFP8 quantized Ascend Flash Attention.`; successful generation alone could be a capability fallback. The disabled opt-in and explicit-backend precedence are covered by CPU tests, not new NPU runs. No NPU accuracy or performance result is claimed.

## CI failure analysis

I reviewed the failed checks for `ceace1a8d392`, compared them with other PRs/main, and checked the code diff. **The current failures appear unrelated to this PR's MXFP8 attention-selection changes.**

### Failing jobs summary

| Job(s) | Failure / relation to this PR |
| --- | --- |
| [NVIDIA `multimodal-gen-test-1-5090`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39710953825/job/123940691599) | Wan DecodingStage and TurboWan E2E latency exceed the performance gates. The **same TurboWan E2E gate also fails on main**: [3186.17 ms vs. 2694.49 ms limit](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40417752787/job/121904342820). The failing Wan runs use `quantization: null`, no component quantization, and no attention-role overrides, so they do not enter the new MXFP8 selection branch. **Existing performance-gate failures, not an MXFP8 backend change on CUDA.** |
| [AMD `multimodal-gen-test-1-gpu-amd (3)`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39710953952/job/123940755882) | Cosmos Dreams fails at `self.assertTrue(queue.stream.query())`. The identical float32 failure occurs in [main's scheduled CI](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39777958482/job/119821718685). **Known stream-cleanup ordering issue**, fixed by #45983 on October 23; this test uses an identity VAE and does not exercise attention backend selection. |
| [AMD `multimodal-gen-test-2-gpu-amd (1)`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39710953952/job/123940755755) | `ltx_2_5_diffusion_decoder_2gpus` repeatedly exceeds the 1200-second startup deadline, eventually hitting the 180-minute step timeout. **Known AMD decoder/warmup issue**: #45861 documents the same failure across scheduled runs and was merged on October 23 to skip this case on AMD. The server uses AITer, not Ascend MXFP8 FA. |
| NVIDIA `bcg-diffusion`, `multimodal-gen-unit-test`, `multimodal-gen-test-1-gpu (0–5)`, and `multimodal-gen-test-2-gpu (0, 1, 4)` | All **11 jobs explicitly fail-fast** because `multimodal-gen-test-1-5090` failed. These are not 11 additional test regressions. |
| [`diffusion-coverage-check`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39710953825/job/123988395936) | **Cascading execution-coverage failure**: fail-fast left test cases unexecuted. This is not a source-code coverage failure in the new selector. |
| NVIDIA Extra / AMD Extra `pr-gate` | Missing `run-ci-extra` opt-in label in this workflow snapshot. **Workflow gates**, not model test failures. |
| `pr-test-finish`, `pr-test-amd-finish`, `pr-test-extra-finish`, `pr-test-amd-extra-finish` | **Cascading summaries** of the failures/gates above. |

### Why the already-fixed AMD issues still appear

This rerun checks out merge snapshot `46fafe87f4bc`, based on main `b453996b7dcd` from **October 22**. It therefore does not include the October 23 fixes/workarounds in #45983 and #45861. I also checked that the CI snapshot still contains the old Cosmos cleanup order (synchronize first, then release outputs).

The new automatic FA selection requires a quantization configuration, and `resolve_mx_fa_scheme()` returns `None` on non-NPU platforms. **The observed failures do not call for changes to this PR's MXFP8 selection implementation.**

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""CPU tests for opt-in Ascend MXFP8 attention backend selection."""
+
+import os
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.attention_roles import AttentionRole
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention import layer, selector
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends import ascend_fa
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import AttentionBackendEnum
+
+
+class MXFP8Config:
+    pass
+
+
+class ModelSlimConfig:
+    pass
+
+
+class TestMXFP8AttentionSelection(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.enterContext(
+            patch.dict(os.environ, SGLANG_DIFFUSION_ENABLE_MXFP8_ATTENTION="true")
+        )
+        self.is_npu = self.enterContext(
+            patch.object(ascend_fa.current_platform, "is_npu", return_value=True)
+        )
+        self.enterContext(
+            patch.object(
+                torch, "npu", SimpleNamespace(get_soc_version=lambda: 260), create=True
+            )
+        )
+        self.ops = SimpleNamespace(
+            npu_dynamic_mx_quant=object(), npu_fused_infer_attention_score_v2=object()
+        )
+        self.enterContext(patch.object(torch.ops, "npu", self.ops))
+        self.server_args = SimpleNamespace(attention_backend=None)
+        self.enterContext(
+            patch.object(
+                selector, "get_global_server_args", return_value=self.server_args
+            )
+        )
+        self.enterContext(patch.object(selector, "forced_attn_backend", None))
+        self.enterContext(
+            patch.object(selector, "_cached_get_attn_backend", self._backend)
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _backend(_head_size, _dtype, _supported, selected):
+        selected = selected or AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            get_enum=lambda: selected,
+            unsupported_requirements=lambda _requirements: (),
+            get_impl_cls=lambda: lambda **kwargs: SimpleNamespace(**kwargs),
+            supports_ring_rotation=lambda: True,
+        )
+
+    def _resolve(self, **kwargs):
+        kwargs.setdefault("quant_config", MXFP8Config())
+        return selector.get_attn_backend(64, torch.bfloat16, **kwargs).get_enum()
+
+    def test_online_and_offline_configs_select_fa(self):
+        for config in (MXFP8Config(), ModelSlimConfig()):
+            with self.subTest(config=type(config).__name__):
+                self.assertIs(
+                    self._resolve(quant_config=config), AttentionBackendEnum.FA
+                )
+
+    def test_disabled_opt_in_keeps_platform_default(self):
+        with patch.dict(os.environ, SGLANG_DIFFUSION_ENABLE_MXFP8_ATTENTION="false"):
+            self.assertIs(self._resolve(), AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA)
+
+    def test_unsupported_configs_keep_platform_default(self):
+        for config in (None, object()):
+            with self.subTest(config=config):
+                self.assertIs(
+                    self._resolve(quant_config=config), AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA
+                )
+
+    def test_non_npu_keeps_platform_default(self):
+        self.is_npu.return_value = False
+        self.assertIs(self._resolve(), AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA)
+
+    def test_missing_operator_keeps_platform_default(self):
+        del self.ops.npu_fused_infer_attention_score_v2
+        self.assertIs(self._resolve(), AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA)
+
+    def test_unsupported_device_keeps_platform_default(self):
+        with patch.object(torch.npu, "get_soc_version", return_value=250):
+            self.assertIs(self._resolve(), AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA)
+
+    def test_cross_attention_keeps_platform_default(self):
+        self.assertIs(
+            self._resolve(is_cross_attention=True), AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA
+        )
+
+    def test_backend_constraints_still_apply(self):
+        self.assertIs(
+            self._resolve(
+                supported_attention_backends={AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA}
+            ),
+            AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA,
+        )
+
+    def test_explicit_backends_and_layer_defaults_take_precedence(self):
+        sdpa = AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA
+        for arg in ("selected_attention_backend", "default_attention_backend"):
+            with self.subTest(arg=arg):
+                self.assertIs(self._resolve(**{arg: sdpa}), sdpa)
+        with patch.object(selector, "forced_attn_backend", sdpa):
+            self.assertIs(self._resolve(), sdpa)
+        with patch.object(self.server_args, "attention_backend", "torch_sdpa"):
+            self.assertIs(self._resolve(), sdpa)
+        with selector.component_attn_backend_context_manager(
+            sdpa, component_name="transformer"
+        ):
+            self.assertIs(self._resolve(), sdpa)
+        with selector.component_attn_backend_context_manager(
+            None,
+            component_name="transformer",
+            backend_by_role={AttentionRole.SELF: sdpa},
+        ):
+            self.assertIs(self._resolve(), sdpa)
+
+    def test_layers_forward_quant_config_and_cross_attention_role(self):
+        with (
+            patch.object(layer, "get_compute_dtype", return_value=torch.bfloat16),
+            patch.object(layer, "get_ring_parallel_world_size", return_value=1),
+            patch.object(layer, "wrap_attention_impl_forward"),
+            patch.object(layer, "_maybe_install_backend_autotune"),
+            patch.object(
+                layer, "_resolve_sp_attention_mode", return_value=("a2a", False)
+            ),
+        ):
+            for cls in (
+                layer.LocalAttention,
+                layer.UlyssesAttention,
+                layer.USPAttention,
+            ):
+                for is_cross in (False, True):
+                    with self.subTest(layer=cls.__name__, is_cross=is_cross):
+                        config = MXFP8Config()
+                        attention = cls(
+                            num_heads=1,
+                            head_size=64,
+                            quant_config=config,
+                            is_cross_attention=is_cross,
+                        )
+                        expected = (
+                            AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA
+                            if is_cross
+                            else AttentionBackendEnum.FA
+                        )
+                        self.assertIs(attention.backend, expected)
+                        self.assertIs(attention.attn_impl.quant_config, config)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
